Graves.why: Trap-clearing gun carry whose ~25-minute window is now funded by the comeback package (30% non-hero cap, tick souls to the two poorest, faster deficit secure) and whose summoner core got faster with Echo Shard 0.5->0.2s — but move speed 7->6.7, -4% bullet damage per boon and a slower, double-jumpable Grasping Hands trim the kiting and poke she needs to reach it.
Graves.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: direct nerfs parsed — move speed 7->6.7, bullet damage per boon -4%, Grasping Hands deploy 0.6->0.8s and easier to double-jump, Borrowed Decree spawn-time cut moved T2->T3. Offsets: Echo Shard post-cast 0.5->0.2s for the summoner core and the comeback package funding her ~25-min window. Tier B held, trend rising -> stable; the 56.5%/40.9% snapshot still conflicts with the KB's 48.5%/21% and needs a recheck.
10-20 Shh...: tier C->B, trend rising — trap-clearing into Venator is a real draft lever, but Barrel Mimics punish her low-HP, two-stamina crate chains and the corridor economy still taxes her scaling window.
10-16 Paint the Town: her gun destroys Venator's traps - genuine utility into an A-tier hero - but the earlier, contested soul economy still deletes her ~25-min scaling line.

Apollo.why: S-tier lane bully whose Riposte now lands reliably (dash fixes, CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn) for a 1.5s disable instead of a 0.8s stun — longer lockdown for picks, but no longer an interrupt for channeled ults, and Healing Booster's gutting thins the sustain shell his spirit bruiser build leans on.

builds.name: Spirit bruiser
builds.notes: Lane-phase spirit poke into flat spirit burst; Healing Booster is out of the shell now that it lost Extra Regen and its +3 flat regen, so Restorative Locket carries the sustain instead. Boundless Spirit and Tankbuster are late-game luxuries (buy_min 22+), not lane items.

builds.name: Spirit support/utility
builds.notes: Team-fight sustain and debuff-clear package that matches the older 'unkillable with Locket + Dispel' read; buy when fights are extended or the enemy has debuffs/heal to answer.

builds.name: Cooldown scaling
builds.notes: Late CDR pivot; these have the best item WRs on the board (Superior Cooldown 55.6%) but low share, so it is a win-more when games run long.

enabled_by: economy/tempo patch (09-16)
comeback-soul gutting
early-Rift resist nerf
Riposte reliability + 1.5s disable (dash fixes, CC refunds)
spirit item pool untouched
tower-dive still open with T3 bullet resist vs the parry-cooldown change
Apollo.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Riposte Pommel Hit is now an immobilize + parry disable, not a stun — 0.8->1.5s (T2 +0.4->+0.6s) with dash reliability fixes and CC refunds on Flawless Advance/Itani Lo Sahn. He loses the channel interrupt (Seven/Bebop/Harrow ults) and Healing Booster's gutting thins his sustain; S held, trend rising -> stable.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; lane pressure converts into lane-adjacent crate routes and Healing Snacks, but the objective-parry change makes the Guardian dive a one-shot decision — S held.
10-16 Paint the Town: no direct change; the objective-parry cooldown-reset removal trims the T3-bullet-resist Guardian-dive chain, but the crate-and-Haunt economy keeps him S.

Silver.why: Front-line gun tank still carried by tempo and Weighted Bola anti-air, but Hunter's Aura now needs line of sight and Spirit Shielding lost 3% resist, so her clumped-fight shred and defensive layer are both thinner; Point Blank is now a real damage slot because Go For The Throat counts it.

builds.name: Gun tank
builds.notes: The default shell — lane-sustain bruiser (97% Stalker, 96% Melee Lifesteal, 90% Restorative Shot) that scales into a front-line DPS tank. Point Blank is now a core slot: its slow extends to 2.5s and its weapon damage feeds Go For The Throat. Delay Hunter's Aura — it no longer shreds through walls, so it is an LOS-fight item only.

builds.name: Utility/anti-CC bruiser
builds.notes: Splashes spirit chip and CC between gun cycles and stacks anti-CC when you must survive the frontline — Unstoppable (42% share, 49.5% WR) and Debuff Reducer are the highest-WR items on her.

enabled_by: frontline/tank archetype up (Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%)
Weighted Bola grounded interrupt (anti-air)
gun-cycle smoothing (dash/light melee don't break cycle)
health/boon and sprint buffs
front-line initiators who start fights for her (Dynamo, Apollo, Lash)
countered_by: CC/debuff spam (Mo & Krill, Bebop, Paradox, The Doorman)
kiting and slows
anti-heal stacking (Decay -55%, Toxic Bullets 40%, Healbane) vs her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot sustain
anti-tank bruisers (Shiv) and enemy Tankbuster buyers
Hunter's Aura no longer shreds through walls; Spirit Shielding 18->15%
matches up badly vs Lash and Drifter
Silver.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: S -> A. Hunter's Aura now requires line of sight (no through-wall shred) and Spirit Shielding 18->15% trim her core slots; anti-heal stacking attacks her Melee Lifesteal/Restorative Shot. Offsets: Go For The Throat now counts Point Blank/Opening Rounds, Point Blank slow 2->2.5s, Bola grounding fixes, and Rat King's nerf eases her worst matchup.
10-16 Paint the Town: no direct change; the contested, earlier soul economy rewards her front-line tempo and Weighted Bola anti-air, so tier S holds.
09-29 City Never Sleeps: no direct change; the frontline/tank archetype is up, but the move from lane tempo to farm-route tempo is roughly neutral for a lane-fight gun tank, and heavy-melee crate routes need a heavy melee she does not build toward (peercontent, low confidence).

Celeste.why: Flying spirit burster whose entire shell — Radiant Regeneration plus Healing Booster — was gutted in the same patch that buffed Decay, Toxic Bullets and stacking Healbane; Shining Wonder 140->125 and the 0.35->0.5 air-drag ratio leave her with no sustain and no safe angle.

builds.name: Spirit sustain-burst carrier
builds.notes: Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster are out of the shell — Spirit Lifesteal (6->8 spirit, 13->15%) plus Torment Pulse (18->22% melee resist) is the new sustain layer. HVR's 60->45% velocity makes the early poke weaker, so upgrade it faster or skip it.

builds.name: Anti-CC / anti-debuff tech
builds.notes: Witchmail is her highest-WR item (60.6%, bought ~24m) — the answer into heavy slow/CC comps, which matter more now that slows bleed air drag. Spirit Shielding 18->15% makes this shell thinner than it was.

enabled_by: High base power + overloaded kit (mobility, four abilities)
Torment Pulse + Greater Expansion AoE around her ult
Ult damage in Mid Boss / Rift fights
Torment Pulse 18->22% melee resist + Spirit Lifesteal 13->15% as the replacement sustain layer
countered_by: Silver — Weighted Bola grounds flyers like her
Slows now bleed air drag (system)
Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster gutted — her sustain shell is gone
Anti-heal stacking (Decay -55%, Toxic Bullets 40%, Healbane) vs regen/lifesteal flyers
Scaling/comeback nerfs — late-scaler into a tempo meta
Ivy — out-sustains her burst window
Lash / Calico — mobile initiators that close and survive
Celeste.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Shining Wonder 140->125 is the note; the real hit is Radiant Regeneration (0.35->0.25 spirit regen scaling, heal-on-cast 65->40, in-combat only) plus Healing Booster losing Extra Regen and +3 flat regen, into buffed Decay/Toxic Bullets/stacking Healbane. Spirit Shielding 18->15%, HVR 60->45% velocity and Metal Skin's +20% gravity compound it; pivot to Spirit Lifesteal + Torment Pulse.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the off-lane/corridor economy gives her no camp or crate income route, and Barrel Mimics tax a low-HP clearer, so the tempo patch keeps her B/falling.
10-16 Paint the Town: no direct change; the contested, earlier soul economy punishes her late-scaling line and buffed Deadman Danny (61% vs her) adds a direct threat; tier B held.

Rat King.why: Still a 116-heavy-melee frontline who opens Tough Crates and wants the forced hub fights, but Scrap Grenade's radius (8m->6m, large 14m->10m) and the banner ult's knockup/radius/duration cuts end his one-button camp clear and his teamfight reset, right as Haunt camps gained +10% HP.

builds.name: Gun bruiser
builds.notes: Near-universal core — Monster Rounds + HVR at ~3 min into Opening Rounds; Rat Swarm strips bullet resist so the Spreadshot/grenade window does the work. Scrap Grenade is no longer a one-button camp clear (radius 8m->6m, large 14m->10m, fuse +0.1s): pull camps with melee first, then grenade the clump.

builds.name: Vitality frontline
builds.notes: Extra Health (91%) and Fortitude (90%) anchor the lead-the-charge build; Superior/Compress Cooldown (57.9%/57.7% WR) are now mandatory rather than optional to cover the banner ult's 180s cooldown.

builds.name: Swarm shred
builds.notes: Leans on Rat Swarm T3 shred plus Mystic Expansion AoE, but no dedicated shred item shows in usage — under-built and data-thin.

enabled_by: Tough Crate routes needing heavy melee — 116 heavy melee, 800 HP, 2.0 regen open guaranteed ~58-soul crates
Forced telegraphed hub fights at Sunken Plaza/Bell Tower — banner ult adds move speed, slow immunity and DR
Gun-carry meta — Rat Swarm's bullet-resist shred and Royal Pestments deflect punish Venator/Silver/Paradox
Heavy-Melee Cauldrons and Healing Snacks 10->14% keep his frontline brawl ticking
Rat King.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: S -> A. Scrap Grenade 70->60 (T2 +70->+60, T3 300->275), radius 8m->6m / large 14m->10m, fuse +0.1s; Rule, Ratannia! knockup halved, 160->180s, 20m->16m, 12s->9s and now goes on cooldown if he is stunned before placing; base bullet -5% and growth -20%. Haunt camps +10% HP finish the one-button clear. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; Tough Crates, grouped chasing Haunts, forced Bell Tower/Sunken Plaza hubs and Barrel Mimics all point at heavy-melee camp-clear frontlines, so the systems patch lifts him A -> S on fit, not numbers - confirm against win rate before locking.
10-16 Paint the Town: notes entry only - added to the weekly release-vote schedule, no balance change; the contested-Haunt economy still matches his heavy-melee crate and AoE-clear kit, so tier held A.

Baba.why: Grounded regen bruiser whose identity was removed twice over: Baba's Brew is now random-order on a 1.5s cycle so she cannot guarantee the silence or barrier she needs, and both Radiant Regeneration (94% buy) and Healing Booster were gutted into a patch that buffed every anti-heal item.

builds.name: Cooldown caster
builds.notes: The regen shell is gone — Radiant Regeneration and Healing Booster were both gutted — so the cooldown/duration line is the build now. Brew order is random each cast on a 1->1.5s cycle: hold the cast until the needed brew cycles in rather than opening fights blind.

builds.name: Spirit bruiser
builds.notes: HP/regen filler to out-sustain Haunt chip and hub fights; Torment Pulse 18->22% melee resist is the only sustain gain, and anti-heal stacking (Decay -55%, Healbane) now cuts straight through it.

enabled_by: Tough Crates need heavy melee and Haunts group-and-sustain-check — Baba clears both with Granny Long Legs melee plus a regen stack
Forced, telegraphed hub fights at Sunken Plaza and Bell Tower reward her AoE hex and silence on grouped enemies
Global slows -20% / air drag 35% favor grounded bruisers over flyers
Heavy-Melee Cauldrons and Healing Snacks 10->14%
countered_by: Anti-heal vs her regen wall: Healbane (now stacking), Decay -55%, Toxic Bullets 40%
Random brew order + 1.5s cycle removes on-demand silence/barrier
Sustain supports that neutralize her grind: Kelvin, Dynamo, Paige
Channel interrupts/silence on her ult: Knockdown, Cursed Relic, Silencer
Burst/mobile gun pressure she can't out-poke: Holliday, Wraith; Plated Armor and Bullet Resilience vs her gun damage
Baba.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: C -> D. Baba's Brew order is random each cast on a 1->1.5s cycle (silence 3->2.75s), spirit-resist scaling 0.1->0.07, Threadsap 22->16s and cleanse now wipes stolen spirit, Granny heavy-melee slow 4->2s; Radiant Regeneration (94% buy) and Healing Booster both gutted into an anti-heal patch. Offsets: Heavy-Melee Cauldrons, Healing Snacks 10->14%.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; the new corridors, grouped Haunt camps and forced Bell Tower/Plaza fights suit her melee-regen clear and arrest the post-10-14 fall, but the barrier/resist cuts still bind - trend falling -> stable at C.
10-14: major kit cut - Brew barrier scaling 1.2->0.7 and base 100->90 with CD 25->27s (later, T2), -7% Base Bullet Resist, spirit-resist scaling 0.12->0.1, Granny Long Legs CD 30->32 with lower light-melee launch and decaying repeat air-melee momentum, Threadsap CD 26->28 with its spirit shred now ending on death; plus Radiant Regeneration 0.04->0.035. Tier B -> C, trend falling.

Solomon.why: Zone-control support whose Bishop is now the damage (0.85 on-square scaling, T3 shred -5%/stack on impact) while Rook Battery 1.3->0.9 and base bullet 30->25 gut the gun lane — and his three worst matchups (Rat King, Baba, Celeste) all ate major nerfs, so the floor rises even as his own numbers fall.
Solomon.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: base bullet 30->25 and -20% headshot gut the HVR/Opening Rounds lane crutch, Rook Battery 1.3->0.9 scaling is a real damage cut, Develop Queen 210->240s; Setup Bishop is now the damage (0.64->0.85 on-square, T1 slow +25%, T3 shred -5%/stack on impact) and checkmate is base kit. Max Bishop over Rook Battery. Three losing matchups (Rat King, Baba, Celeste) ate major nerfs. C held.
7-day check-in (2026-10-16): tier B -> C, WR 45%, PR 61% over 329000 matches. Usage overrides the day-0 'Barrier support' and full-gun builds: Divine Barrier/Healbane/Healing Booster/Superior Duration and Swift Striker do not appear in high-rank item data. Vindicta now reads 48% (even), not the day-0 loss; Baba still 36% despite the 10-14 front-line cut (her barrier 1.2->0.7, -7% bullet resist, B->C).
10-14: no direct change; one week old and the empty Develop Queen tooltip leaves his ult and its Checkmate (200/5) threshold the biggest unknown.

Deadman Danny.why: Spirit mark-burster whose dive got taxed twice: slows now cut jetpack impulse and Steam Vents lost invisibility, so the free approach and the escape are both gone; the Close The Deal damage fix is the only gain on a 730-HP flyer with the air-drag tax intact.
enabled_by: Grouped hub fights (Sunken Plaza ~5-8 min, Bell Tower 8+) that reward mark-then-AoE-dive on stacked targets
Spirit AoE (Mystic Burst, Mystic Expansion, Greater Expansion) into grouped, chasing Haunt camps — the meta's fastest income route
Anchor initiators who hold targets for Strix Salvo marks and Close The Deal: Dynamo, Mo & Krill, Abrams (all A/rising)
Shadow Weave is now the only invis-engage tool — pick angles must be bought, not found
countered_by: Silver's Weighted Bola — S-tier anti-air that grounds him in addition to out-trading his gun
Slows now cut jetpack impulse directly, and harder under movement-ability silence
Silence/knockdown (Silencing Hex, Knockdown) plus Bebop hook catching a committed dive
Plated Armor vs HV Rounds/Opening Rounds poke; Debuff Reducer vs his marks and fading slow
His own whiffed-dive self-stun against the 38s respawn timer at 20 min — a single bad dive is a lost fight
Late payoff vs tempo: Boundless Spirit's ~47-min average buy arrives after the game usually ends
Deadman Danny.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Chimera Mk1 nerfed across the board — jetpack unusable while cursed, CDR per boon -0.4->-0.25s, T3 refund 50->30%, slows now cut jetpack impulse harder (worse under movement-ability silence), grounding pulls land more reliably. Steam Vents lose invisibility and HVR 60->45% velocity hits his lone weapon staple; the Close The Deal damage fix is the only gain. C held, trend rising -> stable.
7-day check-in (2026-10-20): tier C -> C, WR 45%, PR 69% over 446352 matches. Corrected: the usage data kills the 'shred/mark gun' identity - Bullet Resist Shredder does not appear at all, and the real build is spirit (Extra/Improved Spirit, Mystic Burst at 79-90%) with HV Rounds as the lone weapon staple. The old beats list was inverted - Celeste (33%) and Graves (32%) are among his worst lanes, not wins. PR 69.1% is a new-hero novelty spike (previously 0.2% on a two-day sample), so read WR 38.5% and ignore pick rate. Held C/rising: the build finally consolidated and WR gained ~3.6 points, but nothing clears 49% head-to-head and the flyer tax is intact; upgrade only on ~45%+ WR, drop to D if the spirit capstone stays a post-30-min luxury.
10-20 Shh...: no direct change; grouped chasing Haunt camps and corridor farm suit his spirit AoE marks and Steam Vents add approach angles, but the flyer tax and Barrel Mimic risk on a 730-HP commit keep him C/rising.

Violet.why: Zone caster whose ult was cut on every axis at once (180s cooldown, 5s duration, 0.04->0.01 scaling, ends on death, ink destructible again) and whose Still Life regen only ticks while drawing — Spirit Lifesteal 13->15% is the only sustain she has left, into a patch that buffs every anti-heal item.

builds.name: Spirit caster (lead)
builds.notes: Cooldown/regen ramp into T3-T4 spirit; Radiant Regeneration is out and Spirit Lifesteal (6->8 spirit, 13->15%) is the replacement sustain. Only Superior Cooldown (52.9%) and Boundless Spirit (54.4%) beat her 46% baseline, and both land after 24 min.

builds.name: Anti-bruiser sustain
builds.notes: Vitality shell plus Tankbuster (57% share, 49.7% WR, 24.4 min) to chew the Rat King/Mo & Krill/Victor/Shiv frontlines; Healing Booster lost Extra Regen and its flat regen, and the regen half dies to Healbane stacking.

builds.name: Mystic Shot poke
builds.notes: Mystic Shot (47% share, 46.9%) is the only weapon-side item left in her data; the Living Ink / High-Velocity Rounds gun line from the day-0 read has fallen out of usage entirely.

Violet.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: B -> C. Abstract Landscape 165->180s, 6->5s duration, 0.04->0.01 scaling, ends on death, 0.5->0.75s re-apply and T3 ink destructible again; Still Life stun 1.0->0.9s, LOS required at channel end, T1 regen only while drawing (0.25->0.15). Spirit Lifesteal 6->8 spirit / 13->15% is the replacement sustain; anti-heal stacking taxes the rest.
7-day check-in (2026-10-23): tier B -> C, WR 50%, PR 64% over 539876 matches. Data corrects the day-0 read: B/rising was a tooltip judgment, so C is a correction, not a decline — 46.1% WR at 70.9% PR, and she loses to frontline brawlers rather than punishing melee. Watch whether her WR climbs with reps; the tooltip read also claimed Seven and the gun line as wins, but Seven is 49% over 170 and Living Ink/HVR no longer appear in her item data at all. 10-20 Shh...: no Violet changes; her position moves on systems (Haunt grouping, Tough Crates, hub fights) and on the dive/frontline meta around her.

Nurse Harrow.why: Marksman-healer whose Lurking Terrors is now a 5s lockdown with 2s fear buildup and 50% damage reduction instead of immunity, in a patch where Decay, Toxic Bullets and stacking Healbane all cut her healing; the 0.2->0.24 spirit scaling on Healing Needles is the pivot, not a replacement.

builds.name: Mag-dump sustain
builds.notes: The build lands before 10 minutes and buys uptime, not damage: Titanic Magazine (98%) is her fire-rate package and Kinetic Dash plus Extra Stamina buy the dash her kit lacks. Healing Booster is out now that it lost Extra Regen and +3 flat regen, so Extra Regen carries the lane alone.

builds.name: Cooldown/Duration spirit
builds.notes: Every item she buys after ~18 minutes in these games is spirit, and Superior Cooldown (52.7%) and Superior Duration (52.0%) are her two best non-luxury win rates — ability uptime, not raw spirit, is the payload. Lean on Healing Needles' 0.2->0.24 spirit scaling rather than flat heal-per-shot, which was trimmed twice.

builds.name: Ricochet gun carry
builds.notes: Ricochet's 59.1% is the sample's biggest outlier and the natural T4 for a charge economy fed by gun damage, but a 27-minute buy time means part of that win rate is 'already winning'.

Nurse Harrow.notes:
10-30 Halloween + Gameplay Update: Lurking Terrors fear buildup 1.3->2s, duration 7->5s (T3 +3->+2s), T3 immunity -> 50% damage reduction, no fear from >50° above/below the target's view; base gun damage -10%, Healing Needles 25->22 (T2 +20->+16) but spirit scaling 0.2->0.24; Leech Therapy ground leeches 180s -> 120s + 3s/min and cleared on round reset. Anti-heal buffs land on a dedicated healer. B held, trend stable -> falling.
7-day check-in (2026-10-27): tier B -> B, WR 51%, PR 63% over 607252 matches. Data overrides the day-0 read: Swift Striker, High-Velocity Rounds and Active Reload show no meaningful share (Titanic Magazine is the weapon core at 98% / 6.7m), and the 7-day spread contains none of the dash assassins the fear-cone thesis predicted. Extra Regen is not the trap the previous note called it — 97% at 2.1m with a baseline win rate makes it a mandatory lane tax for 0 base regen, indifferent rather than informative. Changelog: released 2026-10-20 in Shh... This Won't Hurt a Bit., first full-week check (7.3k matches, no creator content); nearly every item WR sits at 50.5-51%, so build-level signals are weak and confidence is capped.

change_log: Graves: trend rising -> stable (move speed 7->6.7, -4% bullet dmg/boon, slower Grasping Hands; Echo Shard + comeback package offset)
Apollo: trend rising -> stable; core_items and spirit bruiser build drop Healing Booster (Extra Regen component + flat regen removed), Restorative Locket takes the slot
Apollo: enabled_by swaps 'spirit item pool untouched' for Riposte reliability + 1.5s disable
Silver: tier S -> A (Hunter's Aura now LOS-gated, Spirit Shielding 18->15%, anti-heal stacking vs her sustain)
Silver: core_items and gun tank build add Point Blank (slow 2->2.5s, feeds Go For The Throat); enabled_by swaps early-snowball tempo for the frontline archetype
Celeste: tier B -> C, trend falling; core_items and sustain build drop Radiant Regeneration + Healing Booster, add Spirit Lifesteal
Rat King: tier S -> A, trend rising -> falling; core_items add Compress Cooldown, gun-bruiser build notes rewritten around the smaller grenade and +10% Haunt HP
Baba: tier C -> D, trend falling; core_items drop Radiant Regeneration + Healing Booster, builds restructured to cooldown caster (primary) + spirit bruiser (secondary)
Solomon: notes only — Setup Bishop now the damage line, Rook Battery 1.3->0.9 and base bullet 30->25 gut the gun lane; C held
Deadman Danny: trend rising -> stable; enabled_by drops Steam Vent invisibility, countered_by adds slows cutting jetpack impulse
Violet: tier B -> C, trend falling; core_items and builds drop Radiant Regeneration + Healing Booster, add Spirit Lifesteal
Nurse Harrow: trend stable -> falling; core_items and mag-dump build drop Healing Booster, spirit build pivots to Healing Needles 0.2->0.24 scaling
